startedBy.speaker: Maramal
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias TemplePriest of RelationshipMarriage (The Bonds of Matrimony) (unique)
startedBy.prompt: I might. Why don't you remind me?
reply: Typically, love in Skyrim is as earnest as the people who live here. Life is hard and short, so there is little room for long courtship.
A person who is looking for a spouse simply wears an Amulet of Mara about the neck, showing they are available.
When another person shows interest, and the two agree to be together, one of them comes to the Temple and we arrange a ceremony.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias TemplePriest
startedBy.source: TIF__00074DE5.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:074DE5 (Skyrim.esm)

startedBy.speaker: Maramal
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias TemplePriest of RelationshipMarriage (The Bonds of Matrimony) (unique)
startedBy.prompt: I wanted to know more about the Temple of Mara.
reply: Wonderful. Where to begin?
Mara is the Goddess of Love. The temple spreads her gifts by tending to the sick, the poor, and the lost.
We also perform wedding ceremonies for all the loving couples in Skyrim.

firstObjective.text: Speak to Maramal about arranging your wedding

movedBy.speaker: Maramal
movedBy.prompt: I'd like to have a wedding at the temple.
reply: You wish to be married? It's good to see love blossoming, even during these difficult times.
Your wedding will be held tomorrow, from dawn until dusk.
Don't be late, you don't want to miss your own wedding!
movedBy.conditions: fn403 > 0; fn726 == 0; GetDead == 0; The Bonds of Matrimony stage 30 not done; The Bonds of Matrimony stage 20 done; the speaker is Maramal

movedBy.speaker: Maramal
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias TemplePriest of RelationshipMarriage (The Bonds of Matrimony) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: I made a mistake. I want to go ahead with the ceremony.
reply: "Forgiveness is the heart of Mara's blessings." Very well. We shall re-arrange your wedding.
Tomorrow. Same time as before.

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
